# Five synthetic cases -- actual outputs (generated by run_cases.py; synthetic data)

| # | Scenario | Actual result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Normal | approver publishes verified result | status=PUBLISHED, sync_status=SYNCED, effective_grade=B, placement=B |
| 2 Missing info | empty course / invalid type | ACTION_REQUIRED/ACTION_REQUIRED ; attempts stored=0 |
| 3 Duplicate | same attempt key submitted twice | DUPLICATE ; attempts stored=1 ; grade unchanged=B |
| 4 Unauthorized | other student / unconsented employer / own record | other=None employer=None own returned=True ; denials logged=2 |
| 5 Failed step | sync fails after approval then retried | status=PUBLISHED sync_status=SYNC_FAILED effective_grade=B in_placement=False ; after retry sync_status=SYNCED placement=B audit_valid=True |
